issues.detail: The Hebrew names זֶבַח (Zebah) and צַלְמֻנָּע (Zalmunna) are rendered as 祭物 and 撒勒穆拿. 祭物 means 'sacrifice/offering' in Chinese, which is a mistranslation of the proper name Zebah (which sounds like 'sacrifice' but is a personal name). This changes the proper name into a common noun, causing a reader to misunderstand the identity of the person. The second name 撒勒穆拿 is a transliteration of Zalmunna, which is acceptable. Additionally, the ornament term הַשַּׂהֲרֹנִים (crescent ornaments) is rendered as 撒轄, which appears to be a transliteration error or a different term, but the main issue is the name swap/mistranslation of Zebah.
